The Upside Living studio is AED 500 over your budget but the closest we have in Business Bay. We also have a studio in Laya Mansion in JVC at AED 5,000/month all-inclusive: https://www.propertyfinder.ae/en/plp/rent/apartment-for-rent-dubai-jumeirah-village-circle-district-15-laya-mansion-135620527.html

Are you open to JVC, or would you prefer to stick to Business Bay/Downtown?
